subject: Fractional co-sell packaging & demo ops for EdgeBridge x Redwood bundle
messages:
From: Alex Gomez <alex@edgebridge.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-05-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Partnership: bundled inference + EdgeBridge connector (proposal attached)

Hi Stephanie / Ben,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, EdgeBridge wants to offer a co-sell-friendly listing that bundles our data-connector and orchestration layer with Redwood Inference Dedicated capacity (burst-enabled) as a single transactible offering on AWS and GCP marketplaces.

Quick highlights of the attached spec (edgebridge_redwood_bundle_spec.pdf):
- SKU A: 1-month trial bundle (connector + 100k tokens of dedicated inference)
- SKU B: Annual commitment with metered overage routed through Redwood billing
- Deployment: Customer-managed VPC with optional private link for telemetry

Asks:
1) Can Redwood provide a recommended SKU mapping and entitlement pattern for marketplace display?
2) What telemetry hooks do you need so marketplace co-sell can register leads and attach usage signals?
3) Can we request a demo environment for partner-facing walkthrough (early next week)?

Attach: topology_diagram.png and bundle spec.

Would love to get this into a brief mutual action plan so legal/procurement timelines are visible.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Gomez
Head of Alliances, EdgeBridge AI
alex@edgebridge.ai
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gomez <alex@edgebridge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-05-01T13:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Partnership: bundled inference + EdgeBridge connector (proposal attached)

Alex — thanks for the tidy spec, this is helpful. A few clarifying items from our side so we can scope co-sell enablement properly:

1) Listing ownership / billing flow: is EdgeBridge planning to list and bill directly (Redwood as a secondary entitlement provider), or are we doing a joint listing where Redwood appears on the SKU? That dictates the metering shim we recommend.

2) Telemetry & lead capture: Redwood can emit co-sell signals (lead webhooks + token-usage thresholds) but we need a minimal payload schema. Vivek, can you call out the exact fields we need for HubSpot mapping?

3) Demo / partner test accounts: we can spin up a pre-provisioned demo tenant on our Dedicated fleet; we’ll need the connector test image and a sample corpus (non-prod PII-free). Can EdgeBridge provide the connector test image and a short runbook?

4) Timeline: if procurement wants a 30-day mutual action plan, we should draft MAP and include legal redline windows. Alex — please add a point person from procurement.

Next steps: Vivek, can you review metering/entitlement below by EOD tomorrow? Ben, want you to start a HubSpot record and add a product-stage pipeline entry. Alex — happy to block a 45-minute demo slot Tue/Wed next week.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Alliances — Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Gomez <alex@edgebridge.ai>
Date: 2029-05-02T10:15:00Z
Subject: Re: Partnership: bundled inference + EdgeBridge connector (proposal attached) — metering + SKU mapping

Stephanie / Ben / Alex — attaching a lightweight SKU mapping (sku_mapping_v1.csv) and notes below for how Redwood prefers marketplace entitlements.

Metering & Entitlement notes:
- Recommended model: EdgeBridge lists SKUs in the marketplace; Redwood exposes entitlement tokens via an entitlement API that the connector can redeem to enable Dedicated-capacity credits.
- Fields we need in the entitlement payload: customer_id, marketplace_order_id, sku_id, start_ts, end_ts, token_credit_amount, region, partner_id.
- For co-sell lead signal: we emit a POST to partner webhook when cumulative token usage crosses 10%, 50%, and 90% of committed credits. Payload will include anonymized usage and a link to the HubSpot deal id.

Billing flow options (pick one):
A) Partner-billed: EdgeBridge invoices customer; Redwood invoices EdgeBridge monthly for consumed tokens (preferred for simple partner ops).
B) Marketplace-billed: Marketplace handles billing and forwards credits to Redwood (requires marketplace entitlement integration; longer lead time).

Technical asks from EdgeBridge for demo provisioning:
- Partner to publish connector test image to a public ECR/GCR and provide image reference.
- Small S3-like test bucket with sample corpus.
- HubSpot webhook endpoint for lead capture (or we can use a shared partner webhook).

I can pre-populate the entitlement API and provide a test staging key once we have a sample order id.

Attachments: sku_mapping_v1.csv

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Sr. Product Manager, Marketplace Integrations — Redwood Inference
From: Alex Gomez <alex@edgebridge.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@cloudforge.com>
Date: 2029-05-03T08:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Partnership: bundled inference + EdgeBridge connector (proposal attached) — answers and MAP draft

Thanks Vivek — that mapping is exactly what we needed. Quick answers to the open questions:
- Listing ownership: EdgeBridge will own the listing and bill customers. We want Redwood to be a re-sellable entitlement provider (option A in Vivek's note).
- Demo assets: Priya Shah (cc) will share a public test image and an anonymized corpus by EOD today.
- Procurement: I’m looping Priya for legal/procurement timeline; we typically need a 20-business-day review for standard ISV agreements.

I attached a draft mutual action plan (mutual_action_plan_draft.pdf) with milestones: demo, technical integration, co-sell enablement, legal signoff, marketplace publish. Can Redwood confirm the expected lead times for entitlement API onboarding and a staging order id?

DocuSign: I’ll drop a short SOW + MAP into DocuSign after we align on the billing flow — link will follow.

Alex
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gomez <alex@edgebridge.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@cloudforge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-05-05T15:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Partnership: bundled inference + EdgeBridge connector — action list & owners

Thanks everyone — summarizing agreed next steps and owners so nothing falls through the cracks: 

A) Entitlement API onboarding (Vivek) — provide staging key and example payload by 2029-05-07.
B) Test assets (EdgeBridge / Priya) — public connector image + sample corpus by 2029-05-02 (Priya confirmed shipped).
C) HubSpot / lead signal wiring (Ben) — create HubSpot deal (DEAL-4821) and provide webhook endpoint details by 2029-05-06.
D) Demo runbook & partner-facing tenant (Stephanie / Platform) — provisioning ETA 2029-05-08; schedule 45-min walkthrough with EdgeBridge for 2029-05-09 10:00 PT.
E) Legal / MAP (Alex / Stephanie) — exchange redlines; aim to finalize MAP and SOW by 2029-05-24 to keep procurement on schedule.

Please reply only if an owner needs to reprioritize items. I’ve also linked the HubSpot deal and shared Drive folder here: https://hubspot.company.com/deal/DEAL-4821 and https://drive.redwood.com/Shared/EdgeBridge-bundle-spec.

Thanks — looking forward to the walkthrough.

-Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Alliances — Redwood Inference
